title: Shop Floor Operations App
summary: A web app for a manufacturing business that keeps the shop floor organized: track order payments and deadlines, chat with the team, log timesheets and pull simple reports.

details.heading: The problem
details.text: A small manufacturing business was tracking orders, payments and deadlines across spreadsheets, sticky notes and text messages. Things slipped through the cracks, and nobody had a clear picture of the week ahead.

details.heading: What the app does
details.text:
Orders: see every job, its deadline and whether it's paid, has a deposit or is still unpaid.

Team chat: talk about jobs in one place instead of scattered texts.

Timesheets: the team logs hours against each job.

Reports: simple weekly summaries of output, hours and money owed.
